newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Macau airport reports best month ever.
newsitem.headline: Macau airport reports best month ever.

text.p: Macau International Airport said it set a new record for both passenger and cargo traffic in October making it the best month yet since last December's opening, Macau International Airport Company (CAM) said in a statement.
Traffic in October totalled 149,000 passengers and 3,400 tonnes of cargo, it ssaid.

"This is an excellent surprise for us. Traditionally the highest passenger month for airports in the region is August. We had 146,071 passengers use the airport during August and had expected to drop to about 115,000 passengers in October," said airport company chairman Sousa Moreira.

The statement said the increased cargo throughput reflects the addition of a twice weekly freighter service by South Korea's Asiana Airlines in addition to all cargo flights by Scandinavian Airline Systems and Swissair.

"We have to bear in mind that October and November are the traditional peak times for the air cargo business, so the increase in cargo shipments, although welcome, is not to surprising," Moreira said.

The Portuguese colony's airport said it is now on track to move more than 1.2 milllion passengers through the airport in 1996 and to surpass 18,000 tonnes of cargo. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+44 171 542-5017
